title: ast.batch_apply response
description: Per-file codemod previews plus a roll-up summary. `result` is always `ok`; per-file success or failure is carried on each `files` entry.

result.description: Always `ok`; the batch ran. Per-file outcomes live on each `files` entry.

dry_run.description: Echo of the effective `dry_run`. When true, no file was written.

files.description: One entry per (de-duplicated) input path, in input order.

Summary.description: Roll-up across every file in the batch.

files_total.description: Number of distinct input paths processed.

files_matched.description: Files whose query produced at least one match.

files_changed.description: Files the codemod alters (post-splice content differs from the original). Reported even in dry-run.

files_written.description: Files actually persisted to disk. Always 0 in dry-run.

files_failed.description: Files with a non-applying result (unsupported_language, invalid_query, ambiguous, syntax_error, read_error, parse_error).

match_count_total.description: Total selected matches across all files.

result.description: Per-file outcome. `applied` even when `changed` is false (e.g. an idempotent re-run that matched but produced identical bytes).

match_count.description: Number of selected matches in this file.

changed.description: True when the post-edit content differs from the original.

before_sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the original source. Absent when the source could not be read.

after_sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the post-edit source (equals `before_sha256` for unchanged files). Absent when no splice was produced.

preview.description: Post-edit source (or the original, for non-applying results). Absent when the source could not be read.

details.description: Human-readable explanation for a non-applied result.

health.description: Versioned ParserHealth provenance and coverage contract for this file.
